statement: Between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-25, Russia launches at least 500 drones and missiles combined at Ukraine in a single attack period covered by one Ukrainian Air Force summary.
resolution: TRUE if any Ukrainian Air Force summary for an attack period between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-25, as carried by Reuters, AP or Kyiv Independent, totals 500 or more drones and missiles launched; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: Russia launches fewer than 500 drones and missiles combined in every single attack period between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-25.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: Between 2026-10-05 and 2026-11-30, the US and Iranian governments both publicly confirm a ceasefire, memorandum or deal under which Iran commits to reopen the Strait of Hormuz to commercial shipping.
resolution: TRUE if, between 2026-10-05 and 2026-11-30, both the US government and the Iranian government publicly confirm an agreement committing Iran to reopen Hormuz to commercial shipping, as reported by Reuters or AP; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: The US and Iran conclude no agreement, confirmed by both governments, that commits Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz between 2026-10-05 and 2026-11-30.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class

resolution: TRUE if Reuters or AP report as fact, between 2026-10-05 and 2026-12-31, that Yemeni government or government-aligned forces have taken control of Mocha city from the Houthis; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: Yemeni government and allied forces do not take control of Mocha city at any point between 2026-10-05 and 2026-12-31.

statement: At the FOMC meeting concluding on 2026-10-28, the Federal Reserve raises the federal funds target range above 3.75 to 4.00 percent (Reference: upper bound 4.00 percent on the packet date).

failure_condition: The FOMC holds the target range at 3.75 to 4.00 percent, or lowers it, at the meeting concluding on 2026-10-28.

failure_condition: Every ICE Brent front-month daily settlement between 2026-10-05 and 2026-11-30 stays above 90.00 USD per barrel.
